verdict.rationale: Pricing models are a fair question for a hosted vector database, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never documents serverless, usage-based billing or per-unit costs. The pricing evidence only mentions a free 1GB cluster with no credit card and 'no token limits', which still points to a provisioned cluster model.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pay serverless usage-based pricing with transparent per-unit costs instead of provisioning fixed clusters
